title: The Dense Molecular Gas and Nuclear Activity in the ULIRG IRAS 13120-5453
question: What are the excitation, abundance and kinematics of dense gas tracers (HCN, HCO+, CS) in the ULIRG IRAS 13120-5453, and what do they imply for nuclear starburst/AGN activity and outflows?

data.sensitivity: RMS 1.2 (units missing in text) at 20 km/s

what.value: APEX single-dish HCN and HCO+ fluxes

evidence.quote: IRAS 13120–5453 was observed by (cite: Zhang2014) with the APEX 12m telescope.

what.value: Spitzer mid-IR core size <=2.68 kpc and 80% of emission

evidence.quote: found IRAS 13120–5453 to have an unresolved core with a size of $\leq2.68$ kpc (FWHM) at $13.2~\mu m$
show a $14~\mu m$ flux of $F_{14}=0.5$ Jy
a star formation rate of $\sim170$ yr$^{-1}$

recipe.method: integrated line fluxes and 333 GHz flux from continuum-subtracted cubes
divide total intensity maps, masking where HCO+ not detected at >=3 sigma

recipe.goal: Exploratory LVG modeling of HCN/HCO+ abundance
recipe.method: grids of Radex and DESPOTIC models in density, column and relative abundance
key_parameters: log n=2-7, log N_H2=21-25, abundance ratio 1e-3 to 1e3

recipe.method: kinematic modeling of cubes with GalPak3D; PV diagrams; wings outside virial range flagged as outflow

recipe.goal: Model Herschel H2O lines for dust temperature
recipe.method: compare observed H2O line ratios to grid of radiative transfer models
M~V_circ^2 R/G with V_circ=FWHM/(2 sqrt(ln2)) in 1 kpc diameter
assumptions: intrinsically circular disk gives i~55 deg

recipe.goal: Continuum size, dust and ISM mass, Sigma_IR
recipe.method: 2D Gaussian fit to 333 GHz continuum; dust mass with kappa; Scoville2014 relation
assumptions: gas-to-dust 100; 80% of L_IR in starburst following sub-mm distribution

recipe.goal: Modified blackbody SED fits to Herschel photometry
recipe.method: single- and two-component modified blackbody, beta=1.8, errors by MCMC

evidence.quote: We measure a spatial- and velocity-integrated / ratio of $1.77\pm0.01$.
We find the HCN/HCO$^+$ ratio peaks at $\sim2.8$ over the nucleus
with a $3\sigma$ upper limit of $0.81$ Jy km s$^{-1}$
The best fit, which is also included in Figure [7](#fig:herschel), is achieved with $\tau_{100}=0.5$ $T_{\mathrm{dust}}=40$ K
this implies a dust mass of $2.9\times10^{8}$

answer_key.quantity: upper limit dense outflow mass rate

not_stated_but_needed: line-free channels used for continuum subtraction
clean threshold, cell and image size
how the 3D kinematic fit (GalPak3D) was parameterized
Herschel photometry values for the SED fits
region definitions for 1 kpc aperture spectra
missing_for_reproduction: Briggs robust, line-free channels, CASA version
score_reason: Data public and flux/line measurements reproducible, but imaging parameters and modeling details are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, numeric line fluxes, ratios and continuum size can be redone with standard imaging.
